name: Oxbow Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a Michigan DNR inland lake map (survey year not recorded in the source) (contours digitized by the agency from its survey). No fish-community or water-clarity record is wired for Michigan in v1 - thermal regime, Secchi and fish community use documented fallbacks.
